verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a document-format conversion library and CLI, not an AI agent or LLM host, so acting as an MCP client that calls other servers' tools is outside its product role. Nothing in the evidence shows any agent or MCP-client capability that would make this axis apply. Filters, Lua readers/writers and the pandoc-server HTTP mode are unrelated features and are not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
